scope: Separate explicitly reported sends and acknowledgments by pickup, handoff channel, saved version and recipient. Share activity supplies no recipient baseline.
Typed cook and frozen retailer changes, unresolved items, stale review, named-seat validity and expiry, Free full-copy fallback, local erasure, and retry across restart.

A full, reviewed current copy is used for uncertain destinations, language changes, and custom/private instructions. Older dated records are readable; a fresh source review enables structured comparison.
limits: The Free cook journey was exercised through the simulator UI. Paid comparisons used native real-clock entitlement semantics with fictional membership data.
Recipient labels and acknowledgments are entered manually. No message provider delivery, App Store sandbox, shared-service deployment, physical device, or human Spanish review was exercised.
